errors.evidence: The rotated x tick labels run off the bottom-left edge of the image: the first names are cut off (e.g. '...t of Transportation and Infrastructure', '...inistry of Health and Long-Term Care'), despite the instruction that every label be fully visible.

The agent wrapped each department name onto 2-4 lines before rotating it 60 degrees; the wrapped blocks overprint their neighbours (e.g. 'Department of Justice and Public Safety', 'Agency for Statistics and Data Services' and 'Ministry of Energy, Mines and Low Carbon Innovation' collide), so many names cannot be read.
The legend box in the upper-left corner sits on top of the upper edge of the 'S2 daily range' band around 06-02, so that day's maximum (about 32.1 °C) is hidden behind the legend.
